description: Search GLOBAL voucher codes (Digidip + open-source Caramel/YaPromo/c0upons/coupon-swarm, including USA Caramel feeds). Optional countries filter uses ISO-3166 Alpha-2 (GB, DE, US, …); omit for all. Each result ALWAYS includes voucher_code plus url/go_url — ChatGPT/LLMs must give users both. url is ShopAt-tracked and Digidip-wrapped.

advertiser.description: Filter by advertiser name or domain.

countries.description: Optional ISO-3166 Alpha-2 country codes. Empty/omit = all countries.

country.description: Single country code alias for countries=[code].

q.description: Keywords: retailer, domain, code or offer text (min 3 chars for live Digidip search).

name: search_vouchers
title: Search Digidip vouchers (worldwide)
